links.outcome: ChatGPT diagnosis and treatment plan accuracy compared with pediatric dentists on same cases
links.effect: ChatGPT 80% accuracy, equal to two dentists and lower than the 90% of the other two; no significant difference (p = 0.926).
links.quote: Statistical analysis revealed no significant difference between the performance of ChatGPT and the pediatric dentists (p = 0.926).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning on 10 pediatric dental case vignettes compared to pediatric dentists without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
